XY series · BKT

BREAKthrough

Released November 4, 2015 · 165 cards

Expanded

BREAKthrough is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on November 4, 2015. Its main set has 162 cards, plus 3 secret rares numbered beyond the set (165 in total). It includes 142 Pokémon, 21 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

43 illustrators worked on BREAKthrough. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (23), Kouki Saitou (8), Toyste Beach (8), Mitsuhiro Arita (7), Masakazu Fukuda (6), Megumi Mizutani (6), Akira Komayama (5), Kagemaru Himeno (5).
